cost.details: An ally in Reach 4 is attacked

system.description:
Reaction: When an ally in Reach 4 is attacked. You may use That All You Got?! affecting that ally instead of yourself.

[A] Target the ally (or pick one within Reach 4 when asked), then choose how many Fury Dice to expend: That all you got?!’s reduction (STR+DEX per die, plus your other TAYG bonuses) is banked on the ally and spent by the next damage they take. The dice leave your pool, with an Undo card.
